items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: No, he wasn't in the Army with me. If he was, I didn't know him then.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played all that. Now that's a man doing some singing. He did very smart singing. But I didn't think much of his voice, I don't want to critic him or nothing, but I didn't think so much of his voice. But he used to sing though. And he's a lively fellow, he's long clothed for God.
Did you ever know Hank Benson? Sure, Hank Benson, trombone player. He worked with you, that's right. Yeah. It wasn't him on trombone in the Army though, huh?
No, he wasn't in the Army with me. If he was, I didn't know him then.
